rules.certCourseTitle: ROS 2 Fundamentals: From Linux Basics to Your First ROS 2 Nodes

rubric.label: Works as specified: every requirement in your brief
Uses exactly the names, message types and values in your brief
Clean ROS 2 code: node class, timers/callbacks, logging, no busy loops
Launch file and YAML parameters start the whole project
Report: explains the design and gives the exact commands to run it

deliverables: Every file of your package: node source files, launch file, YAML file, package.xml, and setup.py (Python) or CMakeLists.txt (C++). Include any .msg, .srv or .action file.
A short report: how your nodes work together (which node publishes, subscribes or serves what) and the exact commands to build and run it.
Optional but recommended: the terminal output of a real run, or a link to a short screen recording (unlisted YouTube or Google Drive).

modules.title: Week 7: Describe a robot with URDF
modules.description: Advanced track. Write robot descriptions from scratch: links and joints, shapes, origins in metres and radians, colours, the joint-frame rule and REP 105 frames, a 2-wheeled mobile robot, a 3-DOF arm with a mimic gripper, a 6-DOF arm, and collision and inertia. A live 3D RViz checks every robot you write.

modules.description: Advanced track.
